about: Where a name the reply marks to look up, [Name](check "City"), opens when no search result is its own site: a Google Maps search for the name and its city when it gives one, else a Google search for the name. The server places it when the reply is saved (apps/api/app/modules/chat/name_links.py, test_reply_links.py); the phone opens a marked name the same way while the reply streams (apps/mobile/lib/markdown/replyLinks.ts, lib/__tests__/replyLinks.test.ts). Each address is encoded as encodeURIComponent encodes it.
